Eurovision to Bar Warring Nations From Hosting Future Contests

Eurovision is considering a rule change to prevent countries involved in active conflicts from hosting the song contest. This potential policy shift follows boycotts by several European nations during this year's competition due to Israel's participation. The change is reportedly being considered for the 2027 contest.
